acceptedAnswer.text: Center Jubilee Centre is a private rehab center located in Timmins, Ontario, that provides specialized treatment for mental health, substance abuse, drug addiction, and alcoholism.

mainEntity.name: What is the philosophy and values of Centre Jubilee Centre?

acceptedAnswer.text: Centre Jubilee Centre was founded on humanitarian values, and their treatment philosophy is eclectic and incorporates a wide range of evidence-based cognitive-behavioral approaches. They believe in respecting the dignity of each client, recognition of individual needs, the right to safety, confidentiality, informed consent, and quality of care.

mainEntity.name: What is the integrated treatment model at Centre Jubilee Centre?

acceptedAnswer.text: At Centre Jubilee Centre, the treatment model attempts to illustrate how irrational beliefs and thought processes negatively affect everyday attitudes and behaviors. They encourage clients to assume personal responsibility for their recovery and maintenance of a healthy, fulfilling, and balanced lifestyle. The center’s staff upholds the dignity of each client and encourages client input in their treatment plan

mainEntity.name: What are the specialties of Centre Jubilee Centre?

acceptedAnswer.text: Centre Jubilee Centre specializes in the treatment of mental health, substance abuse, drug addiction, and alcoholism. They offer 12 Step Programs, Substance Abuse Treatment, and Outpatient Drug Rehab.

mainEntity.name: What are the therapies offered at Centre Jubilee Centre?

acceptedAnswer.text: Centre Jubilee Centre offers holistic therapy, evidence-based practices, yoga and meditation, individual therapy and counseling, family therapy and counseling, group therapy and counseling, nutritional counseling, and art and nature therapy.

mainEntity.name: What amenities are provided by Centre Jubilee Centre?

acceptedAnswer.text: Centre Jubilee Centre provides comfortable living arrangements, 24/7 medical care, and on-site support staff.

mainEntity.name: How does Centre Jubilee Centre maximize positive treatment outcomes?

acceptedAnswer.text: Positive treatment outcomes at Centre Jubilee Centre are maximized through effective linkages with hospital, community-based, and consumer-run services through both formal and informal partnerships. The center offers timely access to services in a well-coordinated and integrated system to optimize treatment progress and client outcomes.

about_blocks.text: Centre Jubilee Centre is a private rehab center located in Timmins, Ontario, that provides specialized treatment for mental health, substance abuse, drug addiction, and alcoholism. With a team of expert professionals, the center focuses on providing personalized care to every individual to help them achieve long-lasting recovery.
